records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities relate to advance consideration received from customers or advance billings for which revenue has not been recognized and are reduced when the associated revenue from the contract is recognized.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue recognized during the six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023 that was included in contract liabilities at the beginning of the period amounted to $146,788 and $185,028, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Depreciation expense totaled $40,123 and $39,840 for the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, depreciation expense totaled $79,527 and $77,370, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2024 and 2023, amortization expense was $45,546 and $38,951, respectively.
